subject: Unequal panel border size in raster devices

messages.author: 31c1235796669f0b
messages.subject: Unequal panel border size in raster devices
parts:
Hi list,

I have a double thick line on the bottom and right borders of the panel when I plot the following in raster devices (e.g. png), however pdf are ok (thickness is even).
library("ggplot2")
qplot(mpg, wt, data=mtcars) + opts(panel.border = theme_rect(size = 1))


I suspected this was indeed an other line I couldn't get rid of with panel.border. Although when I set the colour to NA, the potential second line is not displayed, so I don't know.
qplot(mpg, wt, data=mtcars) + opts(panel.border = theme_rect(size = 1, colour = NA))

How can I get rid of this unequal box (I've only tried under Windows 7) ?

Thanks,
Etienne

messages.author: 31c1235796669f0b
messages.subject: Re: Unequal panel border size in raster devices
parts:
It seems that using size = NA, like in :
qplot(mpg, wt, data=mtcars) + opts(panel.border = theme_rect(size = NA))
can be a workaround (which is equivalent to remove it).

Etienne
